1 Organizing file

1.1 GLT

1.2 MST file

library(here)

filenames <- list.files(here("OA-github", "Exp2", "data", "mst"), pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
length(filenames)   
## [1] 307
mstraw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(filenames, fromJSON))

# FALSE: b/c of overlap 
# length(table(mstraw$subject)) == length(filenames)

mstdf <- mstraw %>% dplyr::filter(summary != "NA") %>% dplyr::select(subject, summary) %>% 
  arrange(subject) %>% 
  rename(SID = subject)

mstdf <- mstdf %>% arrange(SID) 

# make summary column neater
tmp <- strsplit(mstdf$summary, split = '\n')

extract_values <- function(item) {
  valid <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[1], ", "))[2:4])
  old <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[2], ", "))[2:4])
  similar <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[3], ", "))[2:4])
  new <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[4], ", "))[2:4])
  rec <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[5], ", "))[2])
  ldi <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[5], ", "))[4])
  
  return(c(valid, old, similar, new, rec, ldi))
}

df_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tmp, extract_values))

df3 <- as.data.frame(df_data)
colnames(df3) <- c("Valid1", "Valid2", "Valid3", 
                   "Old1", "Old2", "Old3", 
                   "Similar1", "Similar2", "Similar3", 
                   "New1", "New2", "New3", 
                   "REC", "LDI")
mstdf <- cbind(mstdf, df3)

mstdf$SID <- as.numeric(mstdf$SID)
mstdf$REC <- as.numeric(mstdf$REC)
mstdf$LDI <- as.numeric(mstdf$LDI)

1.3 merge data

tmp <- merge(good.glt, mstdf, by = "SID", all=TRUE) #n = 307
tmp2 <- tmp %>% filter(!SID %in% bad.glt$SID) #n = 255

#n = 247 (8 were excluded)
mst.g1 <- tmp2 %>% filter(!(Old1+Old2+Old3 < 19.2 |
                Similar1+Similar2+Similar3 < 19.2 |
                New1+New2+New3 <19.2))

# 13 excluded based on REC lower than 0.5, 2 outliers
# 232 remains
mst.g1.tmp <- mst.g1 %>% filter(REC >= 0.5) #234
mst.g2 <- mst.g1.tmp %>% filter(!(LDI %in% boxplot.stats(LDI)$out)) #232

mst.g2 %>% group_by(condition) %>% count()

2 Results: Grid Learning Task performance

# descriptive stats
mst.g2 %>% mutate(all = (score_1 + score_2 + score_3 + score_4) / 4) %>%
  summarize(m_all = mean(all, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_all = sd(all, na.rm = TRUE))
##     m_all   sd_all
## 1 3.56681 1.106777
#     m_all   sd_all
#1 3.530702 1.076194

mst.g2 %>% summarise(g1_m = mean(score_1), g1_sd = sd(score_1),
                     g2_m = mean(score_2), g2_sd = sd(score_2),
                     g3_m = mean(score_3), g3_sd = sd(score_3),
                     g4_m = mean(score_4), g4_sd = sd(score_4))
##       g1_m    g1_sd     g2_m    g2_sd    g3_m    g3_sd     g4_m    g4_sd
## 1 4.534483 1.803945 3.392241 1.594506 3.24569 1.599507 3.094828 1.542913
mst.g2.long <- mst.g2 %>% pivot_longer(cols = c('score_1', 'score_2', 'score_3',
                                                'score_4'),
                                         names_to = 'whichGrid',
                                         values_to = 'RawScore')
mst.g2.long$SID <- as.factor(mst.g2.long$SID)
mst.g2.long$whichGrid <- as.factor(mst.g2.long$whichGrid)

#normality test 
par(mfrow = c(1, 4))

for (g in paste0("score_", 1:4)) {
  qqnorm(mst.g2[[g]], main = g)
  qqline(mst.g2[[g]])
  }

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# RmANOVA
mo <- aov_ez(id = "SID",
            dv = "RawScore",
            data = mst.g2.long,
            within = "whichGrid",
            anova_table = list(correction = "none", es = "pes"))
rmo <- summary(mo)
rmo$sphericity.tests
##           Test statistic p-value
## whichGrid        0.97434 0.30909
mo

emmeans(mo, pairwise ~ whichGrid, adjust = "BH")

3 Results: Effects of overlap type on new learning.

mst.g2.ov <- mst.g2 %>% mutate(score1 = score_2 - score_1,
                                   score2 = score_3 - score_2,
                                   score3 = score_4 - score_3) %>% 
  mutate(none = case_when(condition == 1 | condition == 2 ~ score1,
                          condition == 4 | condition == 5 ~ score2,
                          condition == 3 | condition == 6 ~ score3),
         object = case_when(condition == 3 | condition == 4 ~ score1,
                            condition == 1 | condition == 6 ~ score2,
                            condition == 2 | condition == 5 ~ score3),
         location = case_when(condition == 5 | condition == 6 ~ score1,
                              condition == 2 | condition == 3 ~ score2,
                              condition == 1 | condition == 4 ~ score3))

mst.g2.ov.long <- mst.g2.ov %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c('none','object','location'),
               names_to = 'whichCondition',
               values_to = 'Score')

mst.g2.ov.long$SID <- as.factor(mst.g2.ov.long$SID)
mst.g2.ov.long$whichCondition <- fct_relevel(mst.g2.ov.long$whichCondition,c("none","object","location"))

abbr <- c(none = "none", object = "obj", location = "loc")
mst.g2.ov.long <- mst.g2.ov.long %>% rowwise() %>%
  mutate(position = match(abbr[as.character(whichCondition)],
                          strsplit(as.character(order), "_")[[1]]))
mst.g2.ov.long$position <- as.factor(mst.g2.ov.long$position)

mst.g2.ov.long$Score_r <- -(mst.g2.ov.long$Score)

mst.g2.ov.long %>% group_by(whichCondition) %>% summarise(m = mean(Score_r),
                                                         s = sd(Score_r))
## # A tibble: 3 × 3
##   whichCondition      m     s
##   <fct>           <dbl> <dbl>
## 1 none            0.328  1.89
## 2 object         -0.267  1.89
## 3 location        1.38   1.96
mst.g2.ov.long$Score_rz <- as.numeric(scale((mst.g2.ov.long$Score_r)))

moo <- lm(Score_rz ~  whichCondition + position,
              data = mst.g2.ov.long)

moo2 <- lm(Score_rz ~ whichCondition * position,
              data = mst.g2.ov.long)

anova(moo, moo2) #moo2 is a winning model

summary(moo2)

## position2                        -0.46124    0.14904  -3.095  0.00205 **

# pairwise comparison
emm_w <- emmeans(moo2, ~ whichCondition)
contrast(emm_w, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "none", adjust = "none")

                                        levels = c("object", "none", "location"))

mst.g2.ov.long %>% ggplot(aes(x = whichCondition, y = Score_r, fill = whichCondition)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.3,

                              "location" = "Location overlap"))

5 Results: Relationship between influence of prior knowledge and memory precision.

mst.g2.ov <- mst.g2.ov %>% mutate(obj_none = object - none, 
                    loc_none = location - none)

mst.g2.ov$obj_none_r <- -mst.g2.ov$obj_none
mst.g2.ov$loc_none_r <- -mst.g2.ov$loc_none

# interference ~ LDI
cor.test(mst.g2.ov$obj_none_r, mst.g2.ov$LDI)
## 
##  Pearson's product-moment correlation
## 
## data:  mst.g2.ov$obj_none_r and mst.g2.ov$LDI
## t = -2.2146, df = 230, p-value = 0.02777
## alternative hypothesis: true correlation is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  -0.26829640 -0.01598968
## sample estimates:
##        cor 
## -0.1444908
# facilitation ~ LDI
cor.test(mst.g2.ov$loc_none_r, mst.g2.ov$LDI)
## 
##  Pearson's product-moment correlation
## 
## data:  mst.g2.ov$loc_none_r and mst.g2.ov$LDI
## t = 0.26627, df = 230, p-value = 0.7903
## alternative hypothesis: true correlation is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  -0.1114963  0.1460230
## sample estimates:
##        cor 
## 0.01755451
# graph
mst.g2.ov.diff <- mst.g2.ov %>% pivot_longer(c(obj_none_r, loc_none_r),
               names_to = "whichCondition", 
               values_to = "diff")

mst.g2.ov.diff <- mst.g2.ov.diff %>% mutate(whichCondition = factor(whichCondition,
                                 levels = c("obj_none_r", "loc_none_r"),
                                 labels = c("Object overlap", "Location overlap"))) 

mst.g2.ov.diff %>% ggplot(aes(x = LDI, y = diff, color = whichCondition, fill = whichCondition)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Object overlap" = "#033DA5", "Location overlap" = "#F5C14B")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Object overlap" = "#033DA5", "Location overlap" = "#F5C14B")) +
  facet_wrap(~whichCondition) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-6, 6)) +
  labs(x = "Lure Discrimination Index", y = "X overlap - No overlap") +
  papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

5.1 10,000 simulations

set.seed(2026)
n_sim <- 10000
n_sub <- 200

dat <- mst.g2.ov %>%
  dplyr::select(SID, LDI, obj_none_r, loc_none_r) %>%
  drop_na()
nrow(dat)
## [1] 232
obs <- tibble(
  condition = c("Object overlap", "Location overlap"),
  r_obs = c(cor(dat$LDI, dat$obj_none_r), cor(dat$LDI, dat$loc_none_r)),
  p_obs = c(cor.test(dat$LDI, dat$obj_none_r)$p.value,
            cor.test(dat$LDI, dat$loc_none_r)$p.value)
)

r_to_p <- function(r, n) {
  t <- r * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r^2))
  2 * pt(-abs(t), df = n - 2)
}

sim <- map_dfr(seq_len(n_sim), function(i) {
  s <- dat[sample(nrow(dat), n_sub), ]
  r <- c(cor(s$LDI, s$obj_none_r), cor(s$LDI, s$loc_none_r))
  tibble(sim = i,
         condition = c("Object overlap", "Location overlap"),
         r = r,
         p = r_to_p(r, n_sub))
})

sim_summary <- sim %>%
  left_join(obs, by = "condition") %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    r_obs = first(r_obs),
    mean_r = mean(r),
    r_2.5 = quantile(r, .025),
    r_97.5 = quantile(r, .975),
    prop_sig = mean(p < .05),
    prop_sig_same_direction = mean(p < .05 & sign(r) == sign(r_obs))
  )
sim_summary
## # A tibble: 2 × 7
##   condition        r_obs  mean_r   r_2.5  r_97.5 prop_sig prop_sig_same_direct…¹
##   <chr>            <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>    <dbl>                  <dbl>
## 1 Location over…  0.0176  0.0179 -0.0298  0.0701    0                      0    
## 2 Object overlap -0.144  -0.144  -0.201  -0.0933    0.569                  0.569
## # ℹ abbreviated name: ¹​prop_sig_same_direction
